title: leandra clidemioides subsp. boliviensis
intro: Leandra clidemioides subsp. boliviensis, commonly known as the Bolivian Leandra, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Leandra clidemioides subsp. boliviensis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
